research.name: Yazi
research.note: Terminal file manager in Rust with three-column navigation, inline image previews and a live task progress bar.

effects: inline image preview rendered in the preview column through terminal graphics protocols
three-column parent/current/preview layout with a powerline-style mode and position status bar
background task progress shown live in the status bar as percentage and items left

unverified: Only one extracted frame from each of two demo videos on the features page was viewed; the videos were not watched in motion, so scrolling inside the preview was not observed.
The README demo video (github.com/sxyazi/yazi/assets/...) and the other five feature videos were not opened.
That the image preview uses the Kitty, iTerm2 inline or Sixel protocols comes from the README table, not from the frame itself.
Previews of video, PDF, archive and code files, the Lua plugin system, the virtual filesystem and the package manager are README claims that were not observed.
requiresHostedService is inferred from the README describing a local terminal program; it was not installed or run.
